title: Bose Launches New Wired Earbuds After More Than a Decade
description: The Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds are the first new wired headphones from the brand since 2015, inspired directly by teen preferences. We got an early listen.

description: It's time for dual USB-C smartphones to go mainstream.

title: 5 Reasons To Skip Wireless Headphones
description: There's a lot to like about wireless headphones, especially when you're on the move. But that convenience comes with a few big compromises worth considering.

title: Noble FoKus Amadeus first listen: Enjoyable sound beyond the launch hype
description: At $320, a pair of wireless earbuds should have a useful life beyond its launch season. The Noble FoKus Amadeus arrived in June 2025 and still carries that same official price more than a year later. I'm coming to it…

title: As an audio expert, it's easy to recommend Sennheiser’s Momentum True Wireless 5 — but their predecessors are a lot cheaper at $248
description: The Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 earbuds are undoubtedly impressive, but their arrival means the supremely talented True Wireless 4 have become a lot more affordable.
